name: WHOOP x Diplo's Run Club
why: WHOOP partnered with Diplo's Run Club (5K + music series in eight US cities, 2025-26), running a 'Recovery Station' with live WHOOP data and heart-rate photo moments at select stops (NY, Miami). Lesson: you do not need to own the event; a recovery/data booth at someone else's community run makes the wearable the story.
ask: Copy at Akron scale: offer a free 'recovery + live HRV' table at one Akron/Cleveland social run club's monthly run; seed 5 DevKit bands to the club leads.
opener: Hi - I'm building Vybe, a screenless HRV band, in Akron. We'd love to set up a small recovery table at one of your monthly runs: foam rollers, water, and an optional live heart-rate demo on a screen. No sales pitch, no cost to the club. Could we try it at a run this fall?
geo: US (NY, San Diego, Miami, Phoenix + more)

name: WHOOP x Dubai Fitness Challenge 2025
why: WHOOP was named Official Wearable Sponsor of the city-wide Dubai Fitness Challenge 2025 (30 minutes a day for 30 days), with on-site activations in DFC Fitness Villages plus corporate and community events. Lesson: attach to a civic 30-day challenge; the wearable becomes the proof-of-streak tool.
ask: Pitch a '30-day consistency challenge' with an Akron/Summit County wellness or parks program, with Vybe design partners logging HRV streaks.
opener: Hi - we're an Akron wearable startup (screenless HRV band). Would your team be open to a small 30-day movement challenge this winter where we provide a handful of bands and a simple leaderboard of activity streaks? Happy to keep it low-key and free for participants.

name: WHOOP x PGA TOUR (extension through 2028)
why: WHOOP extended its Official Health & Performance Wearable status with the PGA TOUR and PGA TOUR Champions through 2028, supplying players/trainers across PGA TOUR, Champions and Korn Ferry Tour, with on-site presence in the traveling Player Performance Center and WHOOP Live biometric graphics on World Feed. Lesson: the deal started in 2021 by seeding 1,000+ straps to players and caddies - seeding came before branding.
ask: Copy the seeding-first model: offer bands to the staff (trainers, caddie-equivalents, coaches) of one Ohio developmental tour or college golf program before asking for any logo rights.
opener: Hi - I'm the founder of Vybe, a screenless HRV band built in Akron. We're looking for 5 coaches or trainers to wear our DevKit for a season and tell us what's useless. No logo ask, no cost. Would your staff be open to trying it?

name: WHOOP x Cristiano Ronaldo (ambassador-investor)
why: WHOOP signed Cristiano Ronaldo as official global ambassador and investor, joining an 'ambassador investor' roster (Mahomes, Phelps, Eli Manning, McIlroy). He had been a member for years before the deal. Lesson: the ambassador-investor structure - equity instead of cash - is how a startup gets credible athletes; copy it at micro scale with local athletes and a small advisor/SAFE allocation.
ask: Create a tiny 'athlete advisor' pool: 3-5 Ohio HYROX/tactical athletes who wear Vybe daily, give product feedback, and get advisor equity or a future SAFE slot (lawyer-reviewed).
opener: Hi - you've clearly put real thought into recovery. I'm building Vybe, a screenless HRV band in Akron, and I'm looking for a few athletes to be early product advisors: wear the band, tell us what's wrong. We'd like to talk about a small advisor arrangement. Open to a 15-minute call?

name: WHOOP x Notre Dame Athletics
why: Two-year deal (via Notre Dame Global Partnerships, a Legends/JMI venture) giving select programs WHOOP plus a Team Dashboard for the sports performance staff, with QB Riley Leonard as a content voice. Lesson: the buyer is the sports performance department; the dashboard for staff matters as much as the device.
ask: Offer a one-semester pilot to one Akron Zips or Kent State team's strength & conditioning staff: 10 DevKit bands and a basic team HRV dashboard.
opener: Hi Coach - I'm building Vybe, a screenless HRV band and developer platform here in Akron. We'd like to run a free one-semester pilot with one of your teams: about 10 bands and a simple staff dashboard, and we want blunt feedback. Could we get 15 minutes to see if it fits?

name: WHOOP x University of North Georgia (Institute for Peak Performance + Corps of Cadets)
why: WHOOP became the inaugural wearable partner of UNG's Institute for Peak Performance (spring 2025 pilot with cadets and student-athletes), then UNG equipped all 239 freshman cadets plus the Ranger Challenge and rowing teams (fall 2025) and 54 student-athletes. Lesson: a senior military college pilot, framed around Army H2F doctrine, scaled from a small cohort to a whole class within one year.
ask: Copy directly: pitch a 15-25 cadet pilot to an Ohio ROTC battalion or a senior military college human-performance institute, framed on H2F sleep/readiness. Veteran-owned angle.
opener: Hi - I'm a veteran-owned founder in Akron building Vybe, a screenless HRV band with no GPS and no display. We'd like to offer a small, free pilot for a cadet cohort this semester, tied to H2F sleep and readiness education. Could we set up a 15-minute call with your human performance lead?

name: WHOOP x U.S. Air Force 1st Fighter Wing (aircrew trackers)
why: Air Combat Command's 633rd Contracting Squadron posted a sole-source notice of intent for 372 WHOOP 5.0 'Aircrew Performance Trackers' for the 1st Fighter Wing, with requirements of 10+ day battery, OPSEC compliance (no Wi-Fi, GPS or radio signals) and use inside DoD secure vault facilities. Lesson: the military requirement spec (screenless, no GPS, long battery) is exactly Vybe's form factor; units buy small quantities via notices like this.
ask: Prepare a one-page capability statement for Vybe (screenless, no GPS) and set SAM.gov/HigherGov alerts for 'performance tracker' / 'wearable' notices so the next sole-source notice can be answered within its 3-day window.
opener: Hi - I saw the 1st Fighter Wing's aircrew performance tracker notice. Vybe is a veteran-owned Akron company building a screenless HRV band with no GPS. We aren't ready for that buy, but we'd value 15 minutes to understand what requirements matter most to aircrew human-performance staff.

name: WHOOP x Ryder Cup 2025
why: WHOOP was the Official Health and Fitness Wearable of the 2025 Ryder Cup, showing live heart-rate data of players and captains via WHOOP Live on NBC. Lesson: live biometric overlays are the content hook; at small scale, live HRV on a screen at a local event or stream does the same.
ask: Offer a live-HR overlay to a local HYROX-gym competition livestream or a college club-sport stream as a free content add-on.
opener: Hi - we build Vybe, a screenless heart-rate/HRV band in Akron. For your next livestreamed competition, we'd like to offer a free live heart-rate overlay for 2-4 consenting athletes. You keep the content. Interested in testing it once?

name: WHOOP x Scuderia Ferrari HP
why: WHOOP became Official Health and Fitness Wearable Partner and Team Partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP from the 2026 season (logo on cars and drivers), with WHOOP's performance science team working with Ferrari's medical team across the whole organization. Lesson: the pitch is 'whole-organization' wellbeing, not just star athletes - staff and crew count.
ask: Pitch a regional motorsport or esports team on a whole-crew pilot (pit crew, staff, drivers) with 10 bands.
opener: Hi - I'm the founder of Vybe, a screenless HRV band from Akron. We're looking for one team whose whole crew (not just drivers) would wear our DevKit for a month and share honest feedback. No cost, no logo ask yet. Would that be worth a quick call?

name: WHOOP x Paris Saint-Germain
why: Multi-year partnership through 2029 naming WHOOP a Premium Partner and Official Health & Fitness Wearable of PSG's men's and women's teams, with LED, 3D corner and digital matchday branding. Lesson: WHOOP pairs men's and women's teams in one deal; for Vybe, women's teams are cheaper and under-served.
ask: Approach an Ohio women's semi-pro or college club soccer team with a free season pilot and a co-branded 'recovery week' content series.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a woman-, veteran- and minority-owned wearable startup in Akron. We'd like to support one women's team with a free season pilot of our screenless HRV band and a short recovery content series your players control. Could we talk for 15 minutes?

name: Oura x USTA / US Open
why: Five-year deal naming Oura Official Sponsor and Wearable Fitness Device Partner of the US Open, USTA and USTA Coaching (the USTA's first wearable partner): rings for every Main Draw player via the gifting suite, sponsorship of USTA League National Championships, a Recovery & Readiness module in the USTA coaching certification, and free devices at select coaching events. Lesson: the grassroots coach-education layer (certification module) is the copyable part.
ask: Build a free 45-minute 'HRV and recovery basics' workshop for coaches (e.g., an Ohio high-school coaches clinic or a USA Triathlon/RRCA coaching meetup) and give a DevKit to attendees who join a feedback cohort.
opener: Hi - I'm building Vybe, a screenless HRV band in Akron. We've put together a short, non-salesy 'recovery data basics' session for coaches - what HRV is, what it isn't. Could we offer it free at one of your clinics this season?

name: Oura x U.S. Soccer
why: Long-term deal naming Oura Ring Official Wearable of U.S. Soccer and Founding Partner of the new Arthur M. Blank National Training Center, integrating Oura across 27 national teams. It grew from supporting the USWNT since 2020. Lesson: start with one team (women's) and expand to the federation after years of proven use.
ask: Pick one anchor team (Ohio women's club or college team) for a multi-season relationship rather than many one-off deals.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. Rather than lots of one-off sponsorships, we want one long-term team partner that helps us build the product. Would your staff be open to a no-cost season pilot of our screenless HRV band?

name: Oura x Professional Tennis Players Association (PTPA)
why: Oura provided PTPA members with Oura Ring 4 on a first-come, first-served basis, focused on off-court sleep and recovery. Lesson: a players' association is a cheap distribution channel - one agreement, product to members who opt in, no league rights fee mentioned.
ask: Offer a first-come DevKit allocation to members of a small athlete association (e.g., a pro HYROX athlete group, a veteran athlete association, or a state coaches association).
opener: Hi - Vybe is a screenless HRV band built in Akron. We'd like to offer a small number of DevKits to your members on a first-come basis in exchange for honest feedback. No obligation for members. Could we discuss a simple sign-up?

name: Oura x U.S. Department of Defense (Navy CREW study, Army, AFRL)
why: Oura calls the DoD its largest enterprise customer: tens of thousands of rings since 2019, 1,600 sailors in the Naval Health Research Center CREW fatigue study, 400+ soldiers in an Army field-exercise study, and a Fort Worth plant opening in 2026 for defense contracts. Lesson: the military entry point was research studies (NHRC, DEVCOM, AFRL), not marketing sponsorship.
ask: Pursue a research-partner path: offer DevKits plus raw data access (Vybe's SDK edge) to one military human-performance researcher (AFRL at Wright-Patterson, Ohio, is the natural first call).
opener: Hi - I'm a veteran founder in Akron building Vybe, a screenless ECG/HRV band with an open SDK and raw data access. We're looking for one human-performance research group to evaluate the DevKit. Would you be open to a 15-minute call on what your studies need?

name: Garmin x Garmin Marathon Series (Toledo, Ohio)
why: Garmin launched its own wholly owned and produced race series instead of only sponsoring, debuting in Toledo, Ohio (2025-09-21) and Tucson, then Durham (2026-05-02), with Toledo returning 2026-09-20; Brooks, Dexcom, Maurten, Shokz and Therabody joined as collaborators at the expo, course and finish festival. Lesson: own a small event so you own the data story; and Toledo is a two-hour drive from Akron.
ask: Host a Vybe-owned free 'Recovery 5K' or HRV shakeout run in Akron (towpath) in spring 2027 before the May 2027 launch, partnering with one local run club; ask non-competing brands for in-kind items.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. Ahead of our 2027 launch we want to host a free community 5K/shakeout on the towpath with your club as co-host: you set the vibe, we handle permits, water and a recovery tent. Would your leaders be up for a quick chat?

name: Garmin x USA Triathlon
why: Garmin became Official Cycling Computer, GPS Smartwatch, Heart Rate Monitor, Power Meter and Bike Trainer sponsor of USA Triathlon (NGB sanctioning 3,500+ events). Lesson: national governing bodies sell narrow category rights (e.g., 'heart rate monitor'); a startup can ask a state-level or club-level body for a single category.
ask: Ask one Ohio triathlon club or race series for an 'official recovery/HRV band' category (not watch, not HR monitor) in exchange for product and a clinic.
opener: Hi - we're Vybe, a screenless HRV band startup in Akron. We'd like to support your club with a small in-kind package: a recovery clinic and DevKits for coaches. We're not trying to replace anyone's watch - just a recovery-data category. Could we talk?

name: Garmin x Supertri E World Triathlon Championship
why: Garmin renewed for a fifth consecutive year as official sponsor of Supertri E (esports triathlon), supplying HRM-Pro Plus straps, Tacx trainers and Index scales used in-race and providing technical support. Lesson: supplying the measurement hardware the event actually runs on beats a logo - the product is the infrastructure.
ask: Offer to be the heart-rate data provider for one indoor competition (HYROX simulation, gym throwdown, or esports fitness event) so live HR is part of the scoring/broadcast.
opener: Hi - we build Vybe, a screenless heart-rate/HRV band. For your next indoor competition, we'd like to supply bands and live heart-rate data for the heats at no cost, so you can show effort zones on screen. Would you try it at one event?

name: Garmin x Buena Tierra Run Club (Milwaukee)
why: Garmin renewed a partnership with Buena Tierra Run Club, a local Milwaukee community run club, for a second year (2026). Lesson: even the category leader backs single-city community run clubs - this is the most copyable play for a pre-launch brand in Akron.
ask: Sign one Akron community run club as Vybe's first 'founding club': bands for club leaders, a quarterly recovery clinic, and co-branded shirts.
opener: Hi - I'm building Vybe, a screenless HRV band, right here in Akron. We'd love your club to be our first founding club: bands for your leaders, a recovery clinic each quarter, and shirts if you want them. Nothing required in return but honest feedback. Coffee this month?

name: Polar x Team Essent (speed skating)
why: Polar extended its partnership with Dutch speed-skating team Team Essent for two more years; since 2024 athletes and staff have used Polar Loop, Vantage V3 and H10 sensors across skating, cycling, strength and recovery. Lesson: a mid-size brand picks one elite niche team and supplies the full kit for multi-year credibility.
ask: Pick one niche elite-adjacent team (e.g., an Ohio rowing, cycling or Paralympic club) and become its multi-year recovery-data supplier.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a screenless HRV band from Akron. We're looking for one niche team to work with over multiple seasons - bands for athletes and staff, data access for your coaches, and product changes based on your feedback. Open to a 15-minute call?

name: COROS x Jakob Ingebrigtsen
why: COROS signed Olympic champion Jakob Ingebrigtsen in 2024 (PACE 3 + arm-worn Heart Rate Monitor + Training Hub), which later produced a signature PACE 4 edition. Lesson: COROS signs athletes who use the data for 'marginal gains' and turns them into product co-designers and signature editions.
ask: Name one Ohio athlete as a 'data co-designer' for a DevKit feature and credit them publicly (e.g., a named workout or setting).
opener: Hi - you train with real data discipline. I'm building Vybe, a screenless HRV band in Akron, and want one athlete to co-design a feature with us and get credited for it. Would you be open to a 15-minute call?

name: COROS x NextGen high-school runners program (NIL)
why: COROS launched a NextGen program in spring 2024 for the top 50 high school runners, with mentorship calls with pros including Eliud Kipchoge, described by COROS as its NIL program; it also ran a 2024 holiday give-back to the Eliud Kipchoge Foundation. Lesson: mentorship access plus product can stand in for cash NIL for young athletes.
ask: Run a small 'Vybe NextGen' cohort: 10 Ohio college club/HS-graduate athletes (18+), product plus monthly calls with a coach or veteran mentor; no cash.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. We're starting a small cohort of young athletes (18+) who get our DevKit plus monthly calls with experienced coaches and veteran mentors, in exchange for feedback and occasional content. Would you like details?

name: Ultrahuman x HYROX Bengaluru (title partner)
why: Ultrahuman was title partner of HYROX Bengaluru (2026-04-11/12), India's first two-day HYROX, sold out with 8,200+ attendees, in its home city. Lesson: buy title rights to one HYROX race in your home market rather than a global deal; 'hometown brand' is the story.
ask: Ask HYROX US for the entry-level exhibitor/local partner options at the nearest Ohio-region HYROX race and for HYROX affiliate-gym activation rights in Akron/Cleveland; note Amazfit holds exclusive smart-wearable category rights at HYROX events, so position as a gym-level partner, not event wearable.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a hometown wearable startup in Akron. We'd like to understand the smallest local partner or exhibitor options at your nearest Ohio-region race, and whether affiliate-gym activations are possible. We know wearables are an exclusive category, so we're open to other formats.

name: Ultrahuman x UAE Team Emirates XRG
why: Ultrahuman extended its partnership with UCI WorldTour team UAE Team Emirates XRG (Tadej Pogacar), with coaches viewing rider biomarkers (HRV, temperature, sleep stages) through a coaching dashboard. Lesson: a remote coach dashboard is the hook for teams; Vybe's SDK can let a team's own analyst pull the data.
ask: Offer an Ohio collegiate cycling or rowing team a DevKit pilot where their own analyst gets raw data through the Vybe SDK.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron startup with a screenless HRV band and an open SDK. If your team has a data-minded coach or analyst, we'd like to give them raw access for a season pilot and learn what they build. Free, feedback only. Interested?

name: Amazfit x HYROX (official wearable, now global 3-year exclusive)
why: Amazfit became Official Wearable & Timekeeping partner of HYROX in 2024 (two-year deal with a HYROX race mode and HYROX365 integration for training clubs), then signed a three-year global partnership in 2026 as exclusive smart-wearables partner across HYROX events, extending into the HYROX 365 gym/coach network. Lesson: the exclusivity blocks Vybe from HYROX event category rights; the opening is the gym/coach layer and individual HYROX athletes not locked in.
ask: Skip HYROX event rights; partner directly with 1-2 Akron/Cleveland HYROX training-club gyms on a 'race-prep recovery' block (8 weeks, DevKit bands, HRV check-ins).
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. We'd like to run a free 8-week race-prep recovery block with your HYROX athletes: a few screenless HRV bands, weekly check-ins, and a recap for your members. Would you be up for a short call?

name: Samsung Galaxy x NYC run clubs (Almost Friday Run Club, Midnight Runners) + NYCRuns
why: In summer 2025 Samsung partnered with two large NYC run clubs (Almost Friday Run Club, Midnight Runners New York), equipping select participants with Galaxy Watch/Ring and running rest stations (hydration, stretching, sleep/Energy Score education) at NYCRuns races starting 2025-07-13. Lesson: 'rest and recovery' is an open positioning at run clubs - the big brands are pushing it too.
ask: Run a 'rest station' at one Northeast Ohio race (water, stretching, sleep/HRV education) and equip 5 run-club leaders with bands.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a screenless HRV band startup in Akron. At your next race we'd like to host a free rest station - water, stretching, and a short 'what recovery data means' chat. No hard sell. Can we get on your vendor list?

name: Samsung Galaxy x Unrivaled (women's 3x3 basketball league)
why: Samsung is Official Technology and Presenting Partner of Unrivaled (founded by Napheesa Collier and Breanna Stewart); in season two it sponsors the 2026 training camp with Galaxy Watch8 devices, a Samsung Rest Club recovery facility, a 'Rest Day with Me' athlete content series and a fan step challenge. Lesson: a startup women's league took a founding tech partner early; women's leagues are the best price-per-attention.
ask: Become founding wearable partner of a new or small women's league/club in Ohio (e.g., a women's semi-pro or pro-am league) with product plus a 'rest day' content series.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a woman-, veteran- and minority-owned wearable startup in Akron. We'd love to be a founding tech partner for your league in a small way: bands for players, a 'rest day' content series they control, and a fan challenge. Could we talk?

name: Samsung Team Galaxy x college NIL (Cade Klubnik, Jeremiyah Love, Flau'Jae Johnson)
why: Samsung signed Clemson QB Cade Klubnik and Notre Dame RB Jeremiyah Love to Team Galaxy (joining LSU's Flau'Jae Johnson) for a Galaxy Z Fold7 campaign about training and study. Lesson: big brands use NIL for content; a startup can do the same at micro scale with mid-major athletes via NIL marketplaces.
ask: Book 3-5 Akron/Kent State/Ohio athletes through an NIL marketplace for a product-plus-small-fee 'wear it for 30 days' content deal.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron startup making a screenless HRV band. We'd like to offer you a short NIL deal: wear the band for 30 days, share what you honestly learn about your recovery in 2-3 posts, and keep the band. Interested?

name: Google (Fitbit / Pixel Watch) x Stephen Curry (Performance Advisor)
why: Google named Stephen Curry a long-term Performance Advisor across Google Health, Pixel and Cloud: he and his team test the Fitbit Gemini personal health coach and give feedback on algorithms and future hardware; Google also brought AI demos to his Curry Camp for 30 top student athletes. Lesson: 'advisor' framing gives athlete deals product substance - and camps are a cheap activation.
ask: Offer a free demo/data station at an Ohio youth or college sports camp and recruit a camp coach as a named product advisor.
opener: Hi Coach - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. We'd like to bring a free recovery-data demo to your camp and, if it's useful, invite you to be a product advisor who tells us what athletes actually need. Could we talk for 15 minutes?

name: Eight Sleep x Charles Leclerc (ambassador-investor) and 300+ athlete roster
why: Charles Leclerc joined Eight Sleep as Athlete Ambassador and Investor for the 2025 season, adding to a roster of 300+ pro athletes (Taylor Fritz is also an investor). Lesson: a big roster comes mostly from athletes who already use the product; investor-ambassadors are the headline layer.
ask: Track every athlete who uses the DevKit and publish a growing 'who wears Vybe' roster page (with consent) rather than paying a single star.
opener: Hi - you've been wearing the Vybe DevKit for a few weeks. Would you be OK being listed on our early athlete roster page, with a one-line quote in your own words? No payment involved and you can say no or remove it anytime.

name: Eight Sleep x EF Pro Cycling (Tour de France)
why: Eight Sleep was Official Sleep Partner of EF Education-EasyPost at the 2024 Tour de France, providing Pod 4 units for riders; the team's sport-science director cited deep-sleep data from the 2023 season. Lesson: a team doctor's quote about the data is the most credible marketing asset.
ask: In every team pilot, agree upfront that the coach or sport scientist may give a factual quote about what they observed in the data (no health claims).
opener: Hi - we're running free team pilots of Vybe, a screenless HRV band. One ask at the end: if your sport-science staff found the data useful, a factual quote about what they observed. If not, tell us why. Would you consider a pilot?

name: Suunto x UTMB World Series
why: Suunto is Official GPS Watch and Technical Partner of the UTMB World Series (from 2024), with downloadable course maps and on-site expo stands and shake-out runs at most of the 50+ events in 2025. Lesson: the shake-out run at a race expo is a low-cost activation any brand can run, even without official status.
ask: Host an unofficial 'HRV shake-out run' with a local run club the day before a big Ohio race (e.g., Akron Marathon weekend), with permission from the club, not the race.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. The morning before the next big local race, we'd like to co-host an easy shake-out run with your club: coffee after, and a quick look at what pre-race recovery data shows. Free. Want to do it together?

name: Hume Health x Cowdray Park Polo Club
why: Hume Health became official health tech partner of Cowdray Park Polo Club for the 2026 season, with branding and Hume Body Pod prizes for winners and runners-up at every tournament including the Gold Cup. Hume also runs a wholesale program placing the Body Pod in gyms (96+ listed), health centers and clinics. Lesson: product-as-prize at every tournament is cheap, repeated exposure.
ask: Donate Vybe bands (post-launch) or DevKit vouchers as podium prizes at a recurring local event series (gym throwdowns, a race series) instead of paying a sponsorship fee.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. For your next competition series we'd like to provide prizes for the podium in each division at no cost, with a small mention in your recap. Would that work for you?

name: Levels x CrossFit (affiliate network partnership)
why: CrossFit partnered with Levels in 2025 to give its affiliate gyms access to Levels' CGM/lab platform, member dashboards and coaching templates, with a gym affiliate revenue share and a stage slot at the CrossFit Owners & Coaches Conference. Lesson: sell through gym owners with a revenue share plus ready-made challenge templates - gyms become the channel.
why_now: Announced 2025-06-09; Levels listed among 2025 CrossFit Games partners.
ask: Draft a 'Vybe for gyms' page: founding-gym referral share (post-launch), a ready-made 6-week recovery challenge template, and DevKits for coaches; pitch 3 Akron/Cleveland CrossFit or HYROX gyms.
opener: Hi - I'm the founder of Vybe, a no-subscription HRV band from Akron. We're recruiting a few founding gyms: coaches get bands now, members get a ready-made 6-week recovery challenge, and the gym shares in sales after launch. Could I stop by for 15 minutes?

name: Withings x Boston 10K for Women
why: Withings returned as a sponsor of the 2025 Boston 10K for Women (2025-10-11), with a finish-area booth and messaging about women's health across life stages. Lesson: a single women-focused local race is an affordable, on-message sponsorship for a women-owned health brand.
ask: Ask a women-focused Ohio race or women's run club for a vendor/finish-area table (price only if published) and lead with Vybe's woman-owned story.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a woman-, veteran- and minority-owned wearable startup in Akron. We'd love to support your women's race with a finish-area table and a few raffle prizes. Could you send your vendor or sponsor options?

name: Withings x Triathlon Annette K. (Paris indoor triathlon)
why: Withings debuted as an official partner of a small indoor triathlon at the Annette K. sports hub (200+ triathletes and supporters, 2025-12-06), supporting its athlete Amaury Pailloux and talking with participants about health monitoring. Lesson: a global brand took official status at a 200-person event - small events are legitimate first partnerships.
ask: Become 'official recovery partner' of one 100-300 person Ohio event (indoor tri, gym competition, firefighter challenge) for in-kind product and a booth.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron startup building a screenless HRV band. We'd like to be a small official partner of your event: a recovery booth, a couple of prizes, and support for any athlete who wants to try the band. Could you share how partnerships work for you?

name: Opendorse (brand NIL marketplace)
why: Brand-facing NIL marketplace that says working with student-athletes 'isn't just for big sports brands'; supports social promotion and event appearances, and offers help shaping an idea before committing budget, with pitch-to-payment handling.
ask: Submit the brand form and ask for a shortlist of Akron, Kent State and Ohio State athletes in rowing, track, soccer and club sports for a product-plus-small-fee 30-day wear campaign.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a pre-launch wearable startup in Akron. We'd like to run a small NIL pilot with 3-5 Ohio student-athletes: wear a screenless HRV band for 30 days and post honestly about it. What's the smallest campaign you'd recommend?

name: MOGL (NIL marketplace for brands)
why: Compliant NIL marketplace connecting brands to 10,000+ athlete ambassadors with built-in contracts and payments; offers a free discovery call for brands.
ask: Book the free discovery call; ask about geo-targeting Northeast Ohio athletes and product-only/low-cash deal formats.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. We'd like a discovery call about a small NIL pilot with Northeast Ohio athletes, mostly product-based with a modest fee. Can we set up 15 minutes?

name: Icon Source (athlete endorsement marketplace)
why: Athlete endorsement marketplace for brands and agencies to find and sign athlete partnership deals; ran what it calls the first college NIL deal (Boost Mobile).
ask: Create a brand account and compare athlete pricing with Opendorse/MOGL before committing.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a pre-launch wearable startup in Akron looking at a small athlete ambassador pilot. Could you share how brands typically start on Icon Source and what a minimum campaign looks like?

name: RunReach (run club and race sponsorship network)
why: Turnkey running-event sponsorship network for brands: 3,000+ US events (run clubs, 5Ks, halves), product sampling, race-kit inserts, signage and hyper-local targeting; publishes a CHOMPS case study at $0.47 per sample across 24,000 samples.
ask: Ask for a Northeast Ohio-only pilot: race-kit inserts (waitlist card for the May 2027 launch) at 5-10 local races plus one run-club activation.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a pre-launch wearable startup in Akron. We'd like a small Northeast Ohio pilot: race-kit inserts for our launch waitlist and one run-club activation. What would a minimal test look like?

name: Recess (venue sampling network incl. endurance races and gyms)
why: Sampling marketplace across 10,000+ venues (gyms, studios, endurance races such as Motiv Sports events); flat cost per sample, no strict minimum but recommends starting at 500 samples; venues approve each campaign.
ask: Post-launch: run a 500-unit sampling test of a printed 'recovery guide + waitlist' card at Ohio gyms and races; pre-launch, ask if non-consumable samples are supported.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a wearable startup in Akron launching May 2027. We'd like to test a small sampling campaign at Ohio gyms and endurance events. Do you support non-food items or printed offers, and what's the smallest pilot?

name: onbrand (run club and fitness event brand-partner marketplace)
why: Marketplace where run clubs and fitness event hosts apply to 500+ brands (e.g., Nuun, RYSE) for welcome bags, product seeding and PR collaborations; brands list themselves to receive host applications.
ask: List Vybe as a brand partner offering DevKit seeding and recovery clinics to Ohio run clubs, then accept 2-3 local host applications.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron wearable startup. We'd like to list as a brand partner for run clubs, offering recovery clinics and limited band seeding. Can brands restrict offers to a region like Northeast Ohio?

name: Run This (club platform with brand partnerships)
why: Run-club organizing platform where brands can sponsor events and clubs on the platform; brand tools are early and the team asks brands to describe what they need.
ask: Ask for a list of Ohio clubs on the platform and an early-partner arrangement while brand tools are still forming.
opener: Hi - Vybe is a wearable startup in Akron. We'd like to support a few Ohio run clubs on Run This with recovery clinics and limited band seeding. Do you have clubs in Northeast Ohio, and is there an early brand-partner option?

name: HYROX sponsorships (brand partner inquiry form)
why: HYROX's official sponsorship page invites brands inside and outside fitness to inquire via a contact form about in-person and digital touchpoints across races, gym activations and affiliate gym partners. Note Amazfit holds exclusive smart-wearable rights at HYROX events (2026 global deal), so a wearable category ask will likely be blocked.
ask: Submit the form asking only about non-category options (recovery zone, affiliate-gym content, local race village) for the nearest Ohio-region event.
opener: Hi - Vybe is an Akron health-tech startup. We understand smart wearables are an exclusive category at HYROX events. Are there non-category options, such as a recovery zone, local race village presence, or affiliate gym content, at the nearest Ohio-region race?
